info.title: Canon Keeper Backend-first API
info.summary: Client/server contract for Canon Keeper projects, manuscripts, collaboration and user-facing agent workflows.
info.description: Backend-first OpenAPI 3.1 contract for Canon Keeper. Research Chat uses the same canonical resources, commands, private queries and shared Job lifecycle as import and indexing.

post.summary: Report a content-free browser error.
post.description: The browser reports an unhandled error, a rejected promise, a failed code chunk or a render failure without its message, page URL or user text: only the error kind and class, the app surface, the build file and up to five bundle stack positions. Strict local Origin and CSRF are required; reports are rate limited per client. The backend writes one client_error log line.
post.x-authz: Any visitor of the site, signed in or not, may report an error of their own browser; the report reads and changes no account or project data. The log line names the signed-in user, if any.

get.summary: Read the signed-in writer's quotas
get.description: Returns only the signed-in writer's own limits (an operator override or the default), questions, uploads and drawings of the current Moscow day, questions in work, live projects and the text of the projects the writer owns. Questions and uploads over a limit are refused with 429 quota.chat_turns_daily, quota.imports_daily, quota.images_daily (Retry-After until 00:00 Moscow time) or quota.active_turns; projects, books, chapters and text over a limit with 409 quota.projects, quota.project_books, quota.project_chapters, quota.project_characters, quota.account_books, quota.account_chapters or quota.account_characters. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Open the session of the local author with a one-time code of the shell.

200.description: The session of the local author; its cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and lives as long as the window.

localAuthor.summary: Synthetic session of the local author

post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (DA3.3): exchanges the one-time code the shell gave the window — 32 random bytes, good once and for 30 seconds — for a session of the local author, with the strict Origin of the window and the CSRF token before the cookie changes. A code that is unknown, used or late is 403 without telling which; responses are no-store.
post.x-authz: Anonymous exchange of the one-time code of the shell; only the desktop build mounts it, and the session it opens is that of the one local author of the computer.

post.summary: Take a version of the text into a chapter in writing.
post.description: specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md WA7.5: «Вернуть эту версию» puts the version whole in place of the working text; «Взять в главу» puts a piece of it, named by its first and last phrases, in place of a place of the working text, after it, or at the end of the text. The text before goes into a version first, at the revision the page saw. A piece starts the run that checks its seams (the job of the draft), unless the daily limit of rewrites is spent: then the piece stays unchecked. 409 chapter_draft.busy while a run works, 409 chapter_draft.added, conflict at another revision; 400 for a piece or a place that does not stand in its text once.

200.description: The draft with the version taken.

patch.description: Changes what it names at the revision the page saw: a stale revision is 409 conflict. An absent field stays; place null takes the draft out of any book. An edit of plan or chapter marks it as edited: a new run asks first. While a Job works on the draft the edit is 409 chapter_draft.busy, and once the chapter is in the book 409 chapter_draft.added.
patch.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

post.summary: Open the draft that edits a chapter of the book.
post.description: «Править главу» (specs/2026-11-05-voice-full-access.md A8.7): the one draft of «Письмо» that edits the chapter, made with its text as the working text, its title and its place after the chapter before it, or the existing one as it stands, also when its chapter changed in the book since: only reopenChapterFromBook takes the text of the book. The book does not change until replaceChapterFromDraft. 404 for a chapter or a book deleted.
post.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts and the book; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

post.summary: Replace the chapter of the book with the text of its draft.
post.description: «Заменить главу в книге» (A8.7): the working text of the draft, without the marks of what the helper wrote, becomes the next revision of the chapter in both text versions, on its place and under its id, with the title the author confirmed; the text index, the chapter card and the map follow by themselves. 409 chapter_draft.chapter_changed when the chapter changed in the book since the draft took it, 409 chapter_draft.chapter_gone once it is deleted (the draft then goes in as a new chapter), 409 chapter_draft.busy while a Job writes, conflict at another revision of the draft, 422 chapter_draft.no_text for an empty text.

200.description: The draft that now stands on the new revision of the chapter.

post.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts and the book; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

post.summary: Give the chapter back the text it had before the last replacement.
post.description: «Вернуть прежний текст» (A8.7): one step back, as a new revision of the chapter; the draft takes that text too. 400 when there is nothing to return to, the 409 codes of replaceChapterFromDraft otherwise.

200.description: The draft with the previous text, on the new revision of the chapter.

post.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts and the book; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

post.summary: Give the draft of an edit the text its chapter has in the book now.
post.description: «Открыть главу заново» (A8.7.5): the text and the title of the chapter as the book holds them replace those of the draft, so the page asks first; openChapterEdit never does this. 404 or 409 chapter_draft.chapter_gone for a deleted chapter, 409 for a stale revision.

200.description: The draft with the text of the book.

post.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts and the book; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

post.summary: Add the chapter of a draft to its book.
post.description: «Добавить в книгу» (R7.5): one new chapter with the title and the text of the draft, after the chapter named or at the start of the book. Other chapters only move. Its text goes to both text versions and to the text index; no import is spent, the limits of the text hold (409 quota.project_chapters and the like). A repeat answers the draft as it stands and adds nothing. There is no undo: the chapter is deleted as any other. 422 chapter_draft.no_destination without a live place, 422 chapter_draft.no_text without a title or a chapter, 409 chapter_draft.busy, conflict. An actor whose email is not verified gets 403 auth.email_unverified.
post.x-authz: Current project editor/admin/owner writes the drafts; viewers receive 403 and non-member project ids return leak-safe 404.

SagaMapNodeNamedIn.description: A record of the author's materials that names the node.

SagaMapNodeMaterial.description: A record of the author's materials in the card of a node.

beside.description: The names mentioned in the same chapters, the strongest first (R11.1).

hiddenId.description: The decision of the author that took this node off the map (R11.3).

material.description: What the author's record of this name says (R9.5).

namedIn.description: The other records of the author that name it, skills too.

category.description: Null for an entry of another type.

first.description: The first chapter naming it; null when it first appears after the chapter.

mentions.description: Chapters naming it up to the chapter.

SagaMapNodeCard.description: The card of a node of the saga map up to a chapter.

SagaContentsChapter.description: A chapter with the summary of its card; summary is absent while the chapter has no card.

SagaContents.description: Chapter summaries of a book, or the chapters of the whole saga matching a query (at most 200).

draft.description: Omitted for viewers; present for editor/admin/owner access.

bytesTransferred.description: Bytes accepted from the uploaded file by the import job.

bytesTotal.description: Exact uploaded file size in bytes.

parsedChapters.description: Chapters parsed from the uploaded file. Omitted until parsing has completed.

savedChapters.description: Parsed chapters committed by the import transaction.

indexedChapters.description: Chapters whose exact current text-index state is committed.

totalChapters.description: Chapters in the exact catalog revision covered by the text-index job.

importPhase.description: Exact persisted worker phase. Present only for the import step.

startedAt.description: UTC start time of this exact checklist step.

completedAt.description: UTC completion or terminal stop time of this exact checklist step.

jobCreatedAt.description: UTC creation time of the exact persisted job represented by this step.

jobStartedAt.description: UTC time when this persisted job first started; null until claimed.

jobCompletedAt.description: UTC terminal time of the persisted job; null while it is active.

bookId.description: The book an update_book import rewrites or an update_preview import reads.

preview.description: An update_preview import: it writes nothing, and the shelf does not show it as work on the book.

ChapterCardsJobSubject.description: Chapter cards of one project text version, built after its text index.

SagaLayerJobSubject.description: The thread layer of a saga, built from the chapter cards of a text version.

ChapterDraftJobSubject.description: A run of the writing agent over a draft of the section «Письмо»; the author's text stays in the draft.

mode.description: The work of the run (specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md, WA5–WA7; specs/2026-11-07-writing-proofread.md, PR3); write is a finished run of the earlier writing, removed by WA13: history only.

AuthorMaterialsImportJobSubject.description: The Job of an import of the author's materials; the text of the file stays in the import.

error.description: Failure of a failed job; null otherwise. A research_chat_turn that the model did not complete names the model failure class in code: model.usage_limit_exceeded (the model usage limit is exhausted), model.server_overloaded (the model is overloaded or temporarily unavailable, including its rate limit), model.http_connection_failed (the connection to the model failed or broke), model.context_window_exceeded (the chat no longer fits the model context), model.turn_interrupted (the turn was interrupted), model.turn_failed (any other or unclassified model failure).

queuePosition.description: getJob of a waiting chat turn: the number of waiting questions the fair queue takes before it (a writer's k-th waiting question counts with the writer's questions in work plus k - 1). Null for any other Job, state or operation.

cancel.description: Canonical API cancel URL when the job can be canceled.

timeline.description: Exact canonical timeline link; null when the current context cannot access the target.

unchangedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters whose title and text stay, spaces aside.

changedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters with other words or paragraphs.

addedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters the file adds.

removedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters the file no longer has; an update moves them to recently deleted.

punctuationChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters with the same words and other signs, letter case or ё; they keep their card. Absent from results before 2026-11-05.

renamedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters under a new title, whatever their text. Absent from results before 2026-11-05.

ImportPreview.description: What update_book with the same file would change, present on update_preview only (specs/2026-10-27-update-book-from-file.md, UC6). Only the creator of the Job reads the places of its chapters.

newCards.description: Chapters that would get a new card: with other words, and new ones.

threads.description: Whether the threads of the saga would be built anew after the update.

order.description: Place of the chapter in the book after the update; of a removed chapter, its place now.

previousTitle.description: The title before the update of a renamed chapter.

places.description: Up to two places of a chapter with other words or signs; only its creator reads them.

ChapterCardsJobResult.description: Chapters of the text version and the cards this run built.

SagaLayerJobResult.description: What a build of the thread layer holds: chapters read, threads of the registry, books asked about and records kept because their checks failed.

ChapterDraftJobResult.description: The kind of work of a finished run; the text is in the draft.

mode.description: As the mode of its subject; write is history only.

AuthorMaterialsImportJobResult.description: How many candidates an import found; they are in the import.

JobResult.description: Bounded job metadata only. Raw manuscript content and runtime traces are not canonical job result data.
